description: Evidenced losses tools/check_entry_survival.py reports and does not fail on. Each item names one finding exactly (entry key, build, finding) and says why it is accepted and what showed it. An item that matches no failing finding is STALE and fails the run, so remove an item as soon as what it describes stops being reported. A loss that is simply not fixed yet does not belong here.
